rfam.comment: This family represents a conserved element found in the 5' UTR of RNase E mRNA. RNase E is a key regulatory enzyme in the pathway of mRNA degradation in E. coli that is able to auto-regulate the degradation of its own mRNA in response to changes in RNase E activity. This rne 5' UTR element acts as a sensor of cellular RNase E concentration enabling tight regulation of RNase E concentration and synthesis.
